messages.subject: Covariance Latent factor ~ residual
parts:
Suppose I want to estimate the covariance of a latent factor and the residual of an item loading on a different factor..

Given that the residual is an exogeneous variable, there shouldn't be a problem? however I always get an error when trying eg.(using HolzingerSwineford)


HS.model <- ' visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3
textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
speed =~ x7 + x8 + x9
x1~~ speed

'

This doesn't work either:

HS.model <- ' visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3
textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
speed =~ x7 + x8 + x9
x1~~ test*x1
speed ~~ test'

Correlations between residuals are obviously no problem.

What am I missing?

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Covariance Latent factor ~ residual
parts:
There is no parameter matrix to represent that, explicitly. But you can enable it if you turn the residual for the observed variable into a factor, and then free the covariance between factors.
'

HS.model <- ' visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3 
textual =~ x4 + x5 + x6
 speed =~ x7 + x8 + x9

resid=~x1     ## create a common factor for the x1 residual
x1~~0*x1     ## force residual variance to 0, so that teh new factor gets all that variance
speed~~resid  ## covary nwfactor with other factor
'
You may get a hiccup here because x1 is the market variable (loading fixed to 1) for both visual and resid.
If that happens, then just change the order of x1 x2 x3 in the first line of syntax.
